title: Characterization Study of a Level IV Ballistic Plate
content: Ballistic plates classified as Level IV provide the highest level of protection under the NIJ (National Institute of Justice) ballistic standards, they are designed to withstand high-velocity projectiles from rifles and other high-powered firearms. Level IV plates are typically used by military personnel, SWAT (Special Weapons And Tactics) teams, and specialized law enforcement units, in applications where the threat of armor-piercing ammunition is significant [1].
